provenance.instrument: Code of the Municipality of Bethel Park, Chapter 69 Zoning, as published on eCode360
provenance.status_detail: eCode360 (code BE0278): includes legislation through 09-08-2025. New Laws (13). The only Chapter 69 item is Ord. No. 4-13-26A (2026-04-13), which replaces 69.35.4.7 on chickens and ducks. It does not touch dwellings. Read in the eCode360 print view in a browser.
provenance.code_current_through_note: eCode360: Includes legislation through 09-08-2025. New Laws (13). One Chapter 69 amendment (Ord. 4-13-26A, chickens and ducks).
checks: The zoning code has no accessory dwelling unit, accessory apartment or in-law rule. R-1, R-2 and R-3 permit one-family detached dwellings and listed accessory uses (69.23.1, 69.24.1, 69.25.1)

The accessory use list includes 'Servants' quarters or servants' house'. A unit for household employees is a permitted accessory use in R-1 to R-5. No size or other standards are given (69.8.2(8), 69.23.1.7.g)
A nonpaying guesthouse in an accessory building is allowed only for occasional guests, 'not for permanent occupancy by others as housekeeping units' (69.8.2(7))
No section sends unlisted uses to a special exception or conditional use. Every use must conform to the district rules (69.11.1). A second unit for a relative or tenant needs a use variance
Two-family dwellings are permitted in R-4 and R-5 at 4,350 sq ft per dwelling unit and 60 ft wide (69.26.1, 69.26.3, 69.27.1). Also permitted in R-T (69.28.1)
Accessory buildings: 20 ft high in R-1 to R-3. 10 ft from the side line, 5 ft from the rear line, behind the building line and the front face of the house (69.23.2, 69.25.2, 69.35.3.2)
Parking: one space per dwelling unit for a one-family dwelling, two per unit for a two-family dwelling (69.40.1)
Short-term rentals are a conditional use in R-1 to R-5, R-T, C-1 and C-2. Rooms must be in the principal building, not in an accessory structure (69.91)
Landlords file an occupancy report with the Municipal Secretary within 30 days of a lease (45.3.2)
A one-family dwelling may be built on a recorded lot below the district lot area if it meets the other district rules (69.17.1). Nothing allows a second unit on such a lot
Boardinghouses are prohibited in the whole municipality (69.19.1.8)
For side yards a two-family dwelling counts as one building on a single lot (69.35.3.5)
provenance.notes: Zoning office: Planning and Zoning, https://www.bethelparkpa.gov/community-development/planning-and-zoning. Searched Chapter 69 for: accessory dwelling, accessory apartment, in-law, granny, elder, ECHO, carriage, guest house, servant, caretaker, secondary dwelling, accessory living, second dwelling, accessory residential, living quarters, conversion. Pending: the township lists a proposed Adaptive Reuse Ordinance (new 69.92, conditional use for reuse of certain hotel, office and former civic buildings). Not adopted. It does not add ADUs (https://www.bethelparkpa.gov/about/proposed-codes-and-ordinances). Review fixes 2026-11-11: term null, short-term rental rule restated, 69.17.1, 69.19.1.8, R-5 and R-T rows.

term.note: No ADU term. Searched for accessory dwelling, accessory apartment, in-law, granny, elder, ECHO, carriage, caretaker, second dwelling. The accessory use list has 'Servants' quarters or servants' house' (69.8.2(8)), a unit for household employees. It is recorded as an alternative.

status.note: The code has no ADU text.

path.note: No use 'except ... in conformity with the regulations herein specified for the district'. A second unit for a relative or tenant is not listed. A use variance is the path.

fallback_path.note: Same as path. The code has no unlisted-use special exception.

value.name: Servants' quarters or servants' house (accessory use)
value.conditions: Only for household servants. No size, occupancy count or parking standard is given. Accessory building rules apply: 20 ft high, 10 ft side, 5 ft rear, behind the house.

value.name: Two-family dwelling
value.conditions: 4,350 sq ft per dwelling unit, 60 ft wide at the building line. Side yards 10 ft. Two parking spaces per unit within 70 ft of the unit.

value.name: Two-family dwelling
value.conditions: 14,520 sq ft per dwelling unit and 80 ft wide. Side yards 10 ft. Density at most eight units per acre.

alternatives.note: Servants' quarters is the code's only accessory living use. Two-family dwellings are listed only in R-4, R-5 and R-T.

zoning_districts.note: No district lists an ADU. Reading of a silent code.

historic_bypass.note: No ADU text, so no historic path.

value.condition: Servants' quarters only for household servants. A nonpaying guesthouse only for 'occasional housing of guests', 'not for permanent occupancy by others as housekeeping units'.
'No accessory building shall be used for dwelling purposes unless the main building on the lot is also being used for dwelling purposes.'
'No accessory structure can be located in front of the front face of the principal building.'
Short-term rental is a conditional use, inside the principal building only. 'Short-term rentals shall not occupy any accessory structure.'
Landlords file an occupancy report with the Municipal Secretary within 30 days of a lease.
Boardinghouses are prohibited in the whole municipality.

gates.note: Accessory living and rental rules that apply to any second unit.

types_allowed.note: No ADU form is listed. Servants' quarters is a separate accessory use, recorded under alternatives.

max_height_ft.note: Accessory rule, not an ADU rule: 'Accessory building: 20 feet.' R-2 and R-4 take the R-1 heights.

setback_front_ft.note: No number. Accessory buildings 'must be located behind the building line' and behind the front face of the house.

setback_side_ft.note: 'at least 10 feet from the side lot line'.

setback_rear_ft.note: 'at least five feet from the rear lot line'.

separation_ft.note: No distance between buildings on one lot found.

district_yards_bind_accessory.note: Accessory buildings may stand in a rear yard ('except for accessory buildings in a rear yard') at 10 ft side and 5 ft rear.

internal_uses_district_height.note: A unit inside or attached to the house takes the 35 ft dwelling height.

family_only.note: No ADU rule. A family is related persons or up to four unrelated persons as one housekeeping unit.

short_term_rental_banned.note: Not a flat ban. Short-term rental is a conditional use in R-1 to R-5, R-T, C-1 and C-2. 'Short-term rentals shall not occupy any accessory structure.' See gates.

max_adus.note: Reading: 0 means the code allows no ADU. Servants' quarters and two-family dwellings are recorded under alternatives.

reading.value: No ADU row. A one-family dwelling needs one space per dwelling unit. If the second unit counts as a dwelling unit, two in total. If the lot is treated as a two-family dwelling, two per unit, four in total.

min_lot_sqft.note: '1/2 acre (21, 870 square feet) and a width at the building of 100 feet'.

setback_side_ft.note: Each side 20 ft. 20% of lot width, at least 12 ft, on lots of record under 100 ft wide.

setback_rear_ft.note: 'not less than 50 feet or 20% of the depth of the lot, whichever is greater, but it need not exceed 90 feet'. Principal building.

min_lot_sqft.note: 75 ft wide at the building line.

setback_front_ft.note: 40 ft. 35 ft on streets dedicated after August 1, 1994 with 60 ft from building line to road center.

setback_side_ft.note: Each side 12 1/2 ft. 20% of width, at least 10 ft, on lots under 75 ft wide.

setback_rear_ft.note: 35 ft or 20% of lot depth, whichever is larger, up to 60 ft. Principal building.

principal_max_height_ft.note: 'as permitted or required in the R-1 District'.

min_lot_sqft.note: 60 ft wide at the building line.

setback_side_ft.note: Each side 10 ft. 15% of width, at least 6 ft, on lots under 60 ft wide.

setback_rear_ft.note: 35 ft or 20% of lot depth, whichever is larger, up to 45 ft. Principal building.

min_lot_sqft.note: One-family detached. Two-family 4,350 sq ft per dwelling unit.

lot_area_per_unit_sqft.note: Two-family dwelling: '4,350 square feet per dwelling unit'. Open whether a second unit on a one-family lot counts this way.

min_lot_sqft.note: 'As required in the R-4 District'. One-family detached 8,710 sq ft, 60 ft wide.

setback_front_ft.note: 'As required or permitted in the R-4 District'.

lot_area_per_unit_sqft.note: Two-family dwelling '4,350 square feet per dwelling unit' through R-4. Open whether a second unit on a one-family lot counts this way.

min_lot_sqft.note: One-family detached '8,710 square feet per dwelling unit', 60 ft wide. Two-family 14,520 per unit.

lot_area_per_unit_sqft.note: Two-family dwelling '14,520 square feet per dwelling unit'. Open whether a second unit counts this way. Density at most eight units per acre (69.28.7).
